Emulates a
std::unique_ptr
to an event sample.
The
ara::com::SamplePtr
behaves as a
std::unique_ptr
as long as the
event
/
field
is subscribed to, or the
Proxy
it belongs to is not destroyed.
The precondition defined in [SWS_CM_00085] and [SWS_CM_00087] must be fulfilled.
Otherwise it is considered a violation.
Note: The
SamplePtr
is always passed with a const
SampleType
to the callable in
GetNewSamples()
(see [SWS_CM_00701]). Therefore the sample datatype (typename T) and
the
SamplePtr
operators using the sample datatype (typename T) are implicitly declared as
const. This means that the sample data will always be read-only.
